svg.title: Causal mask and cross-attention
svg.desc: Left: a 4 by 4 causal mask. Cells on or below the diagonal add 0, cells above add minus infinity, so after softmax token i only attends to tokens 1 to i. Right: cross-attention with 3 decoder tokens and 4 encoder tokens. Q comes from the decoder, K and V from the encoder output, so the score matrix is 3 by 4 (T_q by T_k) and the output is 3 by d_v.

g.text: and token i only sees tokens 1 to i.

svg.text: Source and target lengths may differ.
